threads.body: In streaming/async streaming paths, `_apply_response_attributes` is called for every chunk. Since `GenerateContentResponse.model_version` is optional, assigning it unconditionally can overwrite a previously captured response model with `None` on later chunks that omit `model_version`, causing `gen_ai.response.model` to be missing on the finished span/event.

The new test only asserts `gen_ai.response.model` on the span, but the PR description says the response model should be recorded on the span/event. Adding an event assertion here would cover the event/log signal too and prevent regressions.
